'''Iscera spaceport''' was a spaceport on [[Iscera]]. Sometime in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]] landed here with his modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] named [[Prodigal|''The Prodigal'']].<ref name="Journal" />
